notes: Written for batch ia-03-x from one page (DG; budget 3-5). The page dates only 1465, 1479-80, 1480, 1499 and 1514; Khotan and the Tibetan, Ladakhi, Balur and Badakhshan conquests are undated and the last four are left out of the shapes. Cliopatria's Moghulistan row (1463-1518) draws the whole Tarim over this land; the moghulistan dossier (ia-02-d) already asks for a Dughlat emirate for the south Tarim to 1514 and the turpan-khanate dossier says the same. Which Moghul khan held Kashgar before 1480 is not on the page. The Dughlat amirs ruled Kashgar earlier (a 1435 Mir Sayyid Ali on the page) but the state is dated from 1465.
